scope: Private Datly 1.0 run-export submission and job-plus-artifact completion
persistence: Both custom components invoke generated report_run, report_export_job, and report_export_artifact readers/writers. They own no SQL or database handle. The parent starts one managed transaction and child writes share its commit/rollback owner.

submission.behavior: Validates the candidate, resolves exact completed run and its persisted snapshots, creates a run-linked queued job, and returns an existing job for an identical export request. Conflicting replays, wrong owner/conversation, incomplete snapshots, malformed candidates and insert failure match the SDK0 store's outcome and durable row count.
submission.contention: Ten two-connection SQLite races leave one durable job. A caller whose initial read snapshot gets typed SQLITE_BUSY/LOCKED can retry the whole invocation after rollback and receives the winner as a replay; this retry is explicit at the caller boundary.

completion.behavior: Uses a matching existing artifact or inserts one derived from the job's owner/reference/format, then marks the running job succeeded. Success, idempotent replay, queued-job rejection, owner denial and late job-update failure match the SDK0 store. Late failure rolls back the inserted artifact.
